note: Seen only on a banner; the name's last letters are cut off by the frame. Identified from public sources on 2026-11-10 (see identified).

triage.why: On Bind's own pages the AI in Bind Flow suggests campaign content and a person approves before anything is sent: "review, approve and send on your terms" (home page) and "Review and approve the campaign before it goes live" (campaign management). Scheduled sends and channel fallback run without a person, but they are described as automation, not as anything that decides. Nothing read says the AI acts on its own. This is not a no: a later public page that shows it acting would reopen the intake.

identified.company: Bind (Bind Technologies), maker of Bind Flow
identified.how: The product name matches the banner, and the company's own press release is datelined at Web Summit Lisbon, 9 November 2026: "announced the launch of Bind Flow at Web Summit 2026". Its home page title reads "Customer Engagement Platform for Every Channel"; the banner's exact tagline was not found on bind.hr, and the stand number is not on any public page read.
